|game_text='''0 side — Rescue The Princess'''

Deploy Central Core, A Power Loss, Detention Block Corridor (with [A New Hope] Leia imprisoned there), and Trash Compactor. For remainder of game, your Death Star sites generate +1 Force for you. You may not deploy Luke of ability &gt; 4 or [Episode I] (or [Episode VII]) Jedi. If Leia is about to leave table (for any reason, even if inactive), imprison her in Detention Block Corridor (cards on her are placed in owner's Used Pile). Once per turn, may deploy a Death Star site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if Leia occupies a Death Star site and A Power Loss is 'shut down.' Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself: While this side up, for opponent to initiate a Force drain, opponent must use +1 Force. Your Death Star sites are immune to Set Your Course For Alderaan. Once per turn, if you just 'hit' a character with a blaster, opponent loses 1 Force. May place Obi-Wan out of play from a Death Star site to cancel a battle just initiated anywhere on Death Star. I Can't Believe He's Gone is canceled. During opponent's draw phase, if opponent did not initiate a battle this turn, may retrieve 1 Force. Flip this card if Leia is not at a Death Star site.

'''7 side — Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself (V)'''

Once per turn, if you just 'hit' a character with a blaster, opponent loses 1 Force. May place Obi-Wan out of play from a Death Star site to cancel a battle just initiated anywhere on Death Star. |rulings=* When the 'For remainder of game' text re-imprisons [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]], she is restored to normal (no longer hit or forfeit = 0, etc).<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Rescue%20The%20Princess%20/%20Sometimes%20I%20Amaze%20Even%20Myself%20%28V%29</ref>
* When the 'For remainder of game' text re-imprisons [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]], it is not considered movement. It is not blocked by e.g. [[You Are Beaten]].
* The 'for any reason' text will even work against an 'all cards' situation, e.g. [[Program Trap]] will send [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] to prison instead of the Lost Pile.
* (7-side) At [[Death Star (Special Edition){{!}}Death Star]] sites that are 'immune to SYCFA', Dark Side's Force drains and battle damage are not canceled by SYCFA.
* (7-side) [[Leia's Blaster Rifle]] creates competing automatic actions. The player whose turn it is chooses whether the 1 Force loss or the character being lost happens first. If the character is lost first, the 1 Force loss does not occur.
* (7-side) If Light cancels a battle (e.g. using [[It's A Trap!]]) that was initiated by Dark, then Dark has 'initiated a battle' and prevents Light from retrieving 1 Force with this Objective.
* (7-side) Excluding [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] from battle will not flip the objective back to the 0-side.
* (7-side) Capturing and seizing [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] (such as with [[IG-88 With Riot Gun]]) will flip the objective back to the 0-side.
